title: ryanjameskennedy/sinklink pipeline parameters
description: Sink-to-patient transmission checks with read QC, assembly, assembly QC and cgMLST/wgMLST allele distances

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

input.description: Path to comma-separated file containing information about the samples in the experiment.
input.help_text: CSV with a header and the columns sample, platform, fastq_1 and fastq_2. platform is illumina or nanopore; leave fastq_2 empty for Nanopore or single-end Illumina reads. sample must match translation_id in --metadata.

metadata.description: Study metadata CSV with translation_id, transmission and growth columns.
metadata.help_text: One row per isolate. translation_id matches sample in --input, transmission names the suspected transmission group and growth is the laboratory species label, mapped to a schema through --species_map. Other columns (studypatientnumber, sample, date, comment) are carried into the distance tables.

outdir.description: The output directory where the results will be saved. You have to use absolute paths to storage on Cloud infrastructure.

multiqc_title.description: MultiQC report title. Printed as page header, used for filename if not otherwise specified.

generic_options.title: Generic options
generic_options.description: Less common options for the pipeline, typically set in a config file.
generic_options.help_text:
These options are common to all nf-core pipelines and allow you to customise some of the core preferences for how the pipeline runs.

Typically these options would be set in a Nextflow config file loaded for all pipeline runs, such as `~/.nextflow/config`.

publish_dir_mode.description: Method used to save pipeline results to output directory.
publish_dir_mode.help_text: The Nextflow `publishDir` option specifies which intermediate files should be saved to the output directory. This option tells the pipeline what method should be used to move these files. See [Nextflow docs](https://www.nextflow.io/docs/latest/process.html#publishdir) for details.

max_multiqc_email_size.description: File size limit when attaching MultiQC reports to summary emails.

monochrome_logs.description: Do not use coloured log outputs.

multiqc_config.description: Custom config file to supply to MultiQC.

multiqc_logo.description: Custom logo file to supply to MultiQC. File name must also be set in the MultiQC config file

multiqc_methods_description.description: Custom MultiQC yaml file containing HTML including a methods description.

validate_params.description: Boolean whether to validate parameters against the schema at runtime

pipelines_testdata_base_path.description: Base URL or local path to location of pipeline test dataset files

trace_report_suffix.description: Suffix to add to the trace report filename. Default is the date and time in the format yyyy-MM-dd_HH-mm-ss.

help_full.description: Display the full detailed help message.

show_hidden.description: Display hidden parameters in the help message (only works when --help or --help_full are provided).

config_profile_name.description: Name of the config profile in use.

config_profile_description.description: Description of the config profile in use.

reference_options.title: Schemas, databases and expectations
reference_options.description: Where to find the chewBBACA schemas and QC databases, and the tables that drive the checks.

schemas_dir.description: Folder holding <schema>/alleles_rereffed, as set up by `make schemas`.
schemas_dir.help_text: Required unless --skip_chewbbaca is set. Isolates whose schema is missing here are assembled and QC'd but not allele called.

kraken_db.description: Kraken2/Bracken database. The read-based species check is skipped without it.

gambit_db.description: GAMBIT database folder for gambitcore (`make gambit_db`). Completeness is not checked without it.

schema_table.description: Thresholds, expected species and genome size per schema. Defaults to assets/schemas.tsv.

species_map.description: Laboratory growth label to schema. Defaults to assets/species_map.tsv.

qc_thresholds.description: Read and assembly QC thresholds per platform. Defaults to assets/qc_thresholds.tsv.

analysis_options.title: Analysis options
analysis_options.description: Read filtering, assembly, species check and allele calling.

trim.description: Trim Illumina reads with Trimmomatic before assembly.

filtlong.description: Filter Nanopore reads with Filtlong before assembly.

assembler.description: Assembler for Illumina reads. Nanopore reads always use Flye and Medaka.

bracken_read_length.description: Read length of the Bracken k-mer distribution to use.

skip_chewbbaca.description: Stop after assembly and QC; no allele calling or distances.
